in_marathi.name: Vidhan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Law, Judgment, Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vidhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who knows the law, the one who has wisdom and judgment, the one who leads.

in_bengali.name: Vidhan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Law, Judgment, Knowledge
in_bengali.long_meaning: Vidhan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The one who knows the law, the one who has wisdom and judgment, the one who leads.
